notes.title: Demo 1.4.1 Update: Fresh Looks, Skill Revamp, and Better Editor!
notes.notes: [p]This is likely the [b]last major update before our full release[/b]—and it’s packed with exciting changes![/p][p]✨ [b]New Look[/b][/p][list][*][p]Brand-new [b]Cubs eye style[/b] for a fresh and expressive vibe.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated tree art with full collision interaction.[/p][/*][*][p]Air walls fade smoother and further, plus toned-down flashy effects.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]⚡ [b]Skill Overhaul[/b][/p][list][*][p]Multiple skills reworked with new effects and sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved balance and smoother in-game performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Switch skills directly inside rooms for faster setup.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🎮 [b]Better Rooms & Editor[/b][/p][list][*][p]Cleaner lobby interface, invite friends without issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Map Editor upgraded with an object height slider and more intuitive drag & drop.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new toggle between continuous and single object placement. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]👀 [b]Observer & Gameplay Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed missing visual/camera effects in observer mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved wall-climbing, start/finish formations, and clearer displacement indicators.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🔊 [b]Audio Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed low volume and synced spectator sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]New skill sound effects for more impact![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Jump back in, try the refreshed skills, and check out your Cubs’ new eyes—you’ll feel the difference. [/p]
